title: 2009 HMMT February Guts Problem 17
statement: How many positive integers \(n \leq 2009\) have the property that \(\left\lfloor\log _{2}(n)\right\rfloor\) is odd?

solutions.text: We wish to find \(n\) such that there is some natural number \(k\) for which \(2 k-1 \leq \log _{2} n<\) \(2 k\). Since \(n \leq 2009\) we must have \(k \leq 5\). This is equivalent to finding the number of positive integers \(n \leq 2009\) satisfying \(2^{2 k-1} \leq n<2^{2 k}\) for some \(k \leq 5\), so the number of such integers is \(2+2^{3}+2^{5}+2^{7}+2^{9}=682\).
